Sandbox_TripwireAlert_SoundRadius_toolti: How far zombies can hear the bell, in tiles. This does not change how far you hear it.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_PlayerHearRadius_t: How far away you can hear the bell, in tiles. Zombies use Zombie hear radius.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_BellVolume_tooltip: How loud the bell is for you, from 0 (silent) to 100 (full).
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_PlayerTrip_tooltip: If enabled, walking onto an armed tripwire rings the bell. Crouch/stealth to pass without breaking the line.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_AnimalTrip_tooltip: If enabled, animals walking onto an armed tripwire ring the bell. Turn this off if livestock or wildlife keep setting it off.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_AttractZombies_too: If enabled, the bell pulls zombies toward the tripwire. If disabled, you still hear the bell but zombies ignore it.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_ArmTime_tooltip: How long it takes to arm, disarm, or pick up a tripwire.
